Personally, I wasn't impressed from the start. I came for a filling and clearly stated I wanted it to be within my social security budget. They confirmed there would be a sterilization fee of 150฿, which I agreed to since it was only one tooth. But the doctor said they wanted to x-ray another tooth that seemed decayed. They asked if there would be any additional charges, and said no, it would be covered by the social security budget. So I went ahead with it. In the end, I paid an extra 350฿! Okay, that's fine, but it felt like a forced purchase, and not okay.

Overall, the service was good.
